item.description: If you’re here, you probably found my phone somewhere. I’d appreciate it if you would email me at johnjwesthoff@gmail.com.

item.title: About Me
item.description: My name is John Westhoff. Friends call me Jeffrey for short. Online, I like the usernames JohnBot and JohnathonNow. I graduated from the University of Notre Dame in May of 2018, with a BS in Computer Science. Before then, I lived in Stanford Hall (pictured above). I once served as the mascot secretary for the Notre Dame Linux Users Group, and they’re the ones who started calling me Jeffrey. After graduating from Notre Dame, I spent the summer running around chanting “37-0” until the Michigan season opener1 started my PhD studies at NYU.
